title: G6PD and machine learning algorithms as prognostic and diagnostic indicators of liver hepatocellular carcinoma.
summary: TCGA/ICGC/GEO cohorts and liver-cancer cell lines are used; qRT-PCR, western blot, knockdown, proliferation/migration assays, and classifier tests are reported.
ai_technology: G6PD expression and machine-learning classifiers are evaluated as diagnostic/prognostic indicators in liver hepatocellular carcinoma, with cell perturbation experiments.
organization: Key Laboratory of Environmental Medicine Engineering of Ministry of Education

evidence.tested: TCGA/ICGC/GEO cohorts and liver-cancer cell lines are used; qRT-PCR, western blot, knockdown, proliferation/migration assays, and classifier tests are reported.
evidence.unknown: Cell experiments support biological relevance; retrospective cohorts do not establish clinical performance.
